Title: Microsoft Cognitive Services | Bing Custom Search API

Body.Content:
Bing Custom Search API is an easy-to-use, ad-free search solution that lets you build a search experience and query content on your website or across a selected set of websites or domains. Bing Custom Search has several new functionalities, integrating statistics, image search, and autosuggest features.

Learn More
